question: In which year did Cripps Mission arrive in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1942**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cripps Mission** arrived in India in **1942** during **World War II**.
 
• The mission was led by **Sir Stafford Cripps**, a member of the British Cabinet.
 
• The purpose of the mission was to secure Indian cooperation and support for the British war efforts.
 
• The mission proposed **Dominion status** for India after the war, but it was rejected by Indian leaders.
 
• Both the Indian National Congress and the Muslim League opposed the proposals, leading to its failure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Cripps Mission** was seen as a last-minute effort by the British to gain Indian support during a critical time in the war.
 
• Its failure led to increased support for the **Quit India Movement** launched by Mahatma Gandhi in August 1942.
 
• The mission is often cited as a significant event in the history of India's struggle for independence.
 
• Despite its failure, the mission highlighted the growing demand for Indian self-governance and eventual independence.
 
• India eventually gained independence on **15th August 1947**.
